title: Sparkly paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='planeLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cfe6ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='planeShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9cc8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5d93cc'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <g transform='translate(18,20)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='translate(82,18) scale(0.7)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='translate(86,62) scale(0.85)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='translate(14,72) scale(0.6)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <g transform='translate(30,12) scale(0.45)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='translate(70,80) scale(0.5)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
    <g transform='translate(84,40) scale(0.35)'>
      <path d='M0,-7 L2,-2 L7,0 L2,2 L0,7 L-2,2 L-7,0 L-2,-2 Z'/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- paper plane -->
  <!-- top wing -->
  <polygon points='50,22 14,58 50,50' fill='url(#planeLight)'/>
  <!-- bottom wing -->
  <polygon points='50,22 50,50 74,64' fill='url(#planeShade)'/>
  <!-- body fold -->
  <polygon points='50,22 50,50 44,62' fill='#7faee0'/>
  <!-- tail tip -->
  <polygon points='50,50 74,64 58,66' fill='#b8d8f5'/>
</svg>
